name: Fantasy Outfits (Male)
description: For male characters only: never give these garments to a female character. Fantasy travel, ceremonial and protective clothing. Garments are alternatives suited to different roles, without assigning a new activity.

studded leather jerkin over woven sleeves
patchwork traveling coat with many repaired seams
wide sash threaded with small metal charms
elven armor
flowing spellcaster robe
ranger cloak

quilted gambeson with side fastenings
